scope: Run the live B550 speculative-decoding gate for the direct IQ4 MTP runtime and isolate whether a regression is caused by Strata's IQ4 kernels, the QAT projections, or the QAT fused-GR modules.

host.gpu: GPU 1, NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3090 Ti, sm_86
host.concurrent_gpu0_work: PID 12164 llama-imatrix using 17,010 MiB on GPU 0; the test used GPU 1 only

model_and_workload.model: Qwen3.8-Flash-Next IQ2_XS/Q2_0 iMatrix-Calibrated 256x2048, first native shard

base.weights: base Q8_0 projections and base BF16 fused GR

full_iq4.weights: ten QAT IQ4 projections and eight QAT fused-GR modules dequantized to BF16

projection_only.weights: ten QAT IQ4 projections, base BF16 fused GR

runtimes.shared_experts: All three use the same 675 MiB experts.bin; base dense provenance is identical to the runtime used by the packer.

kernel_parity.method: Real candidate blocks, deterministic normal inputs, Strata native_iq4_xs_f32/native_iq4_nl_f32 on GPU 1, and independent GGML-dequantized FP32 dot products. Columns 1 through 8 were checked.
kernel_parity.result: all checks passed; differences are consistent with Q8_1 activation rounding, not a block-layout or dispatch mismatch

finding: The IQ4 runtime is executable and verifier-correct, but it fails the live speculative-acceptance gate on this target/workload. Base accepted 68.25%, projection-only QAT accepted 34.95%, and full QAT accepted 13.19%. Since real-block CUDA parity passed, the regression is in candidate-target transfer, not Strata IQ4 block decoding. Both QAT projection transfer and QAT fused-GR transfer reduce acceptance; the GR set reduces it further on this workload.
decision: Do not promote the Flash-Next MTP IQ4 candidate to production. Retain direct IQ4 loader support as tested infrastructure, but keep the existing Q8_0 runtime as the production MTP path.
non_claims: This is one 13,963-token source prompt and 128 generated tokens, not a multi-prompt acceptance sweep.
Prefill was dominated by 167-178 seconds of random PLE reads from a rotational disk on every arm; decode rate is the comparable timing metric, not prefill or wall clock.
The final residual and prompt token stream are identical across arms, proving verifier correctness for this run; window hashes differ because speculative acceptance differs.
GPU 0 had an unrelated llama-imatrix process during the test, but all model runs were bound to GPU 1.
No claim is made about the candidate on the BF16 target model or on workloads matching its training banks.
The teacher-logit top-1 result did not predict live acceptance on this IQ2_XS target; architecture/target transfer remains unproven and now has one negative live measurement.
